physical.comparison_scope: Physical RP2040 timings; finite controlled workloads. Group times weight per-chunk estimates by case count. New reports use medians of opposite-order pair averages from twelve calibrated rounds; legacy reports retain per-library medians from nine rounds. Raw batches and both summaries remain available. Qfplib output error is reported separately.
physical.composed_reference_scope: Explicit Qfplib compositions and algebraic shortcuts, not native Qfplib entry points. Results are independently checked against MPFR; each stream states its base/exponent domain.

accuracy.claim: Finite ARM/MPFR qualification and conditional error bounds; no all-input pow totality proof.

isolation.m4: Both soft/hard ABIs: preprocessing and every allocated code/data byte unchanged.
isolation.generic_m0: Every allocated code/data section unchanged from V60.

limitations: Three measured strict gaps remain. No epsilon/tolerance was used to hide them.
The 1024bit undecided pow trap remains; universal totality is unproved.
The canonical ROOT math remains V51. V67/V68 are private reviewable candidates, not a committed release.
V68 cache-model improvement is not a measured hardware speedup. PicoCalc is handed next to the authorized memcpy test.
